calls.statement:
WITH web_sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_period_label,
    f.member_key,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 47
    AND s.store_id = 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label, f.member_key
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  fiscal_period_label,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN member_key IS NOT NULL THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_sales), 1) as member_share_pct
FROM web_sales_by_period
GROUP BY fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY fiscal_period
